name: promoter
description: Rewards members who advertise the server in their custom status (invite link or server tag) with a configurable role, removed automatically when the status changes. Includes log cards and a persistent check-me panel.
short: Auto-role for members advertising the server.
endUserDataStatement: Processes Discord user presence text in real-time to check for server promotions. Stores per-member cached state (status text, tag flag, role flag) per guild; does not store personal profile data outside the bot instance.
end_user_data_statement: Processes Discord user presence text in real-time to check for server promotions. Stores per-member cached state (status text, tag flag, role flag) per guild; does not store personal profile data outside the bot instance.
author: Antigravity

configFields.label: Promoter Role
configFields.description: Role granted to members advertising the server.

configFields.label: Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for grant/revoke log cards. Leave blank to disable.

configFields.label: Match Terms
configFields.description: Phrases to look for in custom status (e.g. the server invite slug).

configFields.label: Detect Server Tag
configFields.description: Also grant the role to members wearing the native server tag.
